purpose: Three structural pixel-fantasy UI concepts for user selection; layout reconstruction requested.
commonPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished UI/UX ART DIRECTION MOCKUP for WizardCard, a desktop fantasy pixel-art tactical spell card game. Full straight-on game viewport, 1920x1080 landscape 16:9, richly considered structure, all UI drawn in crisp pixel-art fantasy visual language, readable Chinese UI text, clear typography on quiet panel interiors. This is a COMPLETE LAYOUT RECONSTRUCTION, not a reskin of the reference screenshot. The reference only supplies game concepts and card-art subjects. DO NOT copy its huge empty rectangular formation tiles, header, side HUD placements or monolithic detail panel. Organize meaningful information into diverse sizes and functional groups: main battlefield; host formation containers holding spell cards with progress/status/rune badges; visible casting queue; word/ambush public area; chain resolution; immediate task/action area; hand; compact player resources; optional details/log. Leave breathing room, not vast empty boxes. Interesting designed structure rather than all information in identical rectangles.

GAME SCENE common to three concepts: WizardCard wordmark. Turn 8, main phase, current player acting. Five-phase strip (抽卡 / 准备 / 主要 / 施法 / 结束), 主要 active; compact settings/log controls. Opponent life30/40, mana8/12, load2/10; player life38/40 mana3/12 load8/10. Opponent private hand only five card backs with visible count, never face-up. Each side has FIVE formation space units; hexagram base occupies TWO units, auxiliary formation occupies ONE and TWO units are vacant. Render this occupancy as a small FIVE-unit track / span bracket, NOT five gigantic empty cards. Two visible formed HOST GROUPS per player, each group combines one formation emblem, capacity/rank/ring summary and nested spell slots; player base hosts fireball analyzing1 and ward ready; auxiliary hosts one small violet spell. A narrow dedicated CASTING QUEUE has two prepared spell tiles; word/ambush area shows one face-up silver quill and one facedown rune card, ash/deck as small count indicators. Central public chain display is clearly marked 空闲 / 暂无连锁 with explanatory reverse-order arrows or dormant chain sockets, never invent an active chain. SIX hand cards at bottom: 火球术 / 炽燃结界 / 奥术圆环 / 逆三角星符 / 阿克乌姆之弧 / 心如止水. Selected HAND fireball, lifted and outlined; floating local action 开始解析 near its card. Separate READ-ONLY fireball details: illustration, title, costs 解析3 / 施法1, 位阶2, speed1, concise readable rules. No execution button inside details. Current TASK text 选择卡牌开始操作; a clear dedicated end-main-phase action. Source selection, target candidates and costs use different graphical marks. No action-per-turn limit or action tokens. Heart/crystal/burden resource icons, bar/tick displays; numeric labels. Close-up full UI that can actually be used; do not draw a distant tabletop diorama. Preserve safe margins and full unclipped screen. No unrelated characters or scenic background competing with the UI. Chinese text should read cleanly, avoid fake dense body paragraphs. Differing mockups keep SAME comparable gameplay content but distinct layout and structure.

assets.name: 古铜仪式战场
assets.prompt: CONCEPT A: BATTLEFIELD CENTER / 古铜仪式战场. Rebuild the match around a large tactile slate ARENA, aged brass edges and emerald inlays, classical medieval ritual dueling atmosphere. TOP BAR is slim with opponent horizontal vitals integrated near the upper battlefield. LOWER PLAYER VITAL STRIP sits immediately above hand. CENTRAL area uses two HOST GROUP CLUSTERS per side, thin horizontal formation-space ticks above them and nested miniature spell rows BELOW each emblem, making host association obvious. A designated central casting bridge and separate narrow left chain/task rail form the primary action corridor. RIGHT INSPECTOR is slimmer, split into visual card preview upper, rule/instance tabs lower, not one tall wall of text. LEFT PUBLIC RAIL vertically stacks chain state, casting status, compact graveyard counts and phase hints, avoiding duplicated HUD cards. Full-width bottom HAND DOCK with six readable cards, left deck stack / sort chips and right end-phase control; selected card's floating action above the hand. Deliberately varied surfaces: inset field clusters, raised hand cards, narrow rune ribbons for statuses, compact dot occupancy; tiny angular corner details, thin frames, restrained ornament. Dark stone navy #101923, antique bronze #9B7448, muted warm gold #E0BE7C, teal #72D7C5. Icon+label information; visual emphasis on spells and actionable flow rather than empty slots. Polished and rich information architecture, classic pixel RPG craft.
assets.layout: 上下双方阵法分组、中央施法区、左侧连锁和公共区、右侧只读详情；资源条贴近各自场地。
assets.tradeoff: 战场氛围最强，装饰密度较高，定稿时需要控制角饰和纹理对比。

assets.name: 秘银星图工作台
assets.prompt:
CONCEPT B: TACTICAL WORKBENCH / 秘银星图. A SIGNIFICANTLY DIFFERENT UI architecture from ordinary big arena with side panels. COOL and airy pixel-fantasy silver, midnight indigo and lavender (#10162B #25334B #BBC7E2 #8ABFE8 #B3A0E0), restrained cyan selected outline. Inspired by a medieval astronomer's tactical instrument, NOT sci-fi holographic HUD. Thin angular silver frames, engraved tiny stars, low-contrast midnight constellation pattern, quiet flat interiors, no bronze/gold dominant. More functional with less ornamental weight.

LAYOUT: upper-left compact two-player vitals stacked as slim horizontal ribbons; TOP CENTER phase progress and priority banner; TOP RIGHT settings. Main content is THREE deliberately asymmetric functional columns: LEFT ~18% width is vertical TURN/CHAIN/DECISION TIMELINE with a clear current-task card at its top, small public word/ambush strip and deck/ash count dock below. MIDDLE ~58% is a LARGE uncluttered diagrammatic TACTICAL GRID: opponent two host groups across top of grid, player two across lower grid. Each host group is a medium circular engraved star sigil on left of its own silver rounded-corner-STEPPED rectangular rail, with attached spell thumbnails in a horizontal rail and distinct progress dots under them. Five-unit occupancy tracker is tiny in group header. FOUR host groups unified by thin right-angle association lines, not a gigantic ritual circle. Center of grid is a dedicated TWO-LANE release/response bar: next-cast queue tiles left, public idle chain flow arrows right. Formation, casting, words and ash regions clearly titled. RIGHT ~24% is an INSPECTOR DRAWER with tabs 卡牌 / 宿主 / 记录, fireball art cropped only by contain not cut off, compact cost chips and organized readable rule snippets, separate status row. Do not use a tall illustrated parchment card inspector. BOTTOM continuous silver HAND RAIL shows six cards with compact large silhouettes, separate cost pips, raised selected fireball and floating action above; sort chips left, END PHASE on bottom-right just outside inspector. Graphical logic, readable state markers, intentional varied module widths, active hotspots obvious, high clarity but rich fantasy craft. Include a slim MINI TASK FLOW underneath header: 查看 → 目标 → 确认 (current inspect). Everything crisp visible pixel style; no gradients, no modern smartphone dashboard, no plastic glass panels.
assets.layout: 左侧操作步骤和当前任务、中间宿主法术分组及施法队列、右侧分页详情、底部手牌。
assets.tradeoff: 信息层级与任务引导最明确，适合复杂对局和规则学习。

assets.name: 双页羊皮卷魔典
assets.prompt:
CONCEPT C: TWO-PAGE GRIMOIRE / 羊皮卷魔典. DRAMATICALLY DIFFERENT INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE. The screen itself becomes a LARGE FLAT open enchanted grimoire with TWO broad readable PARCHMENT PAGES, seen straight-on with zero perspective, taking about the upper 64% of screen. Borders are precise PIXEL-ART burgundy leather / old gold clasps, pages ivory/oat/sepia (#E9D8AE #F5E8C9 #796044), ink dark brown, accents jade and muted red. Restrained manuscript ornamental pixel corners, clear letterpress-like headers and ink line dividers; fantasy book feeling from functional panels, not excessive swirls. Much lighter than the two dark variants.

OVERRIDE ordinary opponent-above-player layout: LEFT BOOK PAGE is OPPONENT FIELD and RIGHT BOOK PAGE is PLAYER FIELD, separately clearly headed 对手 / 本方, with corresponding horizontal life/mana/load bars directly beneath each heading. Opponent five card backs as small cropped bookmarks across LEFT top; player resource identity jade, opponent burgundy. EACH page vertically stacks TWO compact HOST CHAPTERS, formation geometric emblem on left and nested spell cards on right; small five-unit occupancy tab at page header shows base span2 / auxiliary span1 / empty2. Chapternames and line connectors convey hierarchy. No giant bare square tiles. Below host chapters on each page, small PUBLIC WORD/AMBUSH DOCK and CASTING QUEUE with count chips; graveyard/deck are small margin tabs. The narrow CENTRAL BOOK SPINE is a VERTICAL PUBLIC CHAIN RESOLUTION ribbon with numbered idle nodes and reverse-order arrow, label 暂无连锁, not a giant unused rectangle. Its neutral spine visually separates the two players.

BOTTOM 32% is a DEDICATED ACTIVE-CARD WORKSPACE rather than a tall right sidebar: BOTTOM-LEFT about 22% width is read-only selected fireball REFERENCE CARD with modest artwork, costs and 2-3 clean lines of rules in an ivory sheet (name 火球术, 解析3 / 施法1, 位阶2). BOTTOM CENTER/RIGHT is horizontal SIX-CARD HAND SHELF laid on burgundy leather, large legible compact card tops, art and cost pips. Selected fireball lifted, its local 开始解析 action directly ABOVE this hand card, not inside readonly reference. Along very bottom a THIN FIVE-PHASE BOOKMARK STRIP shows turn8 and active main phase plus current task; far bottom-right a prominent JADE WAX-SEAL RECTANGULAR END-PHASE BUTTON with clear text 结束主要阶段. Topmost slender title band says WizardCard and compact settings/log. Functional parchment page tabs labeled 阵法 / 法术 / 记录, with spell-progress beads, ring occupancy and independent rune badges. Occupied units and available ring slots must be visually distinct. Charming scholarly tactile pixel RPG, mature and legible, intentionally editorial spaciousness, crisp silhouettes, restrained magical teal accents. No modern app dashboard, no dark blue giant inspector, no scrolled ancient undecipherable text, no vector-smooth gold calligraphy. Fine clean Chinese labels, exact same comparable resource totals and six hand-card content.
assets.layout: 左右书页承载对手与本方，中央书脊显示连锁，底部集中选中卡牌详情、手牌和阶段操作。
assets.tradeoff: 结构变化最大，主题辨识度高；定稿时需要检查两侧身份和底部中文阅读空间。
